Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this nail biting game of cricket. We saw almost 800-runs being scored but in the end it was England who held their nerves and won the game. We head to St. Lucia for the final match of the series. Hope you enjoyed the coverage of this game. Join us for the final ODI on Saturday. That match begins at 1100 local (0300 GMT). Till then, Cheers!

England skipper, Eoin Morgan, says it was a one hell of a game of cricket and he hopes everyone enjoyed it. Says Adil Rashid got them back in the game and adds that they were in the back foot till the last 15 overs. States that Bairstow and Hales set it up for them in batting. Adds that Buttler is built like a champion and when he gets going it is tough to stop him. Admits Gayle almost took the game away from them and they needed something special with the ball and Adil Rashid provided it. Explains Adil is a strong asset and he is willing to bowl anywhere when required. He got nice rhythm after bowling short to Gayle. States that it was a 50-50 game and could have gone anywhere, and he feels Adil Rashid won them the game with the ball.

Man of the match - Jos Buttler says it was an incredible game of cricket and admits they were put under pressure by Windies and Gayle. Says it is fantastic to get the record and states that the team had decided to have a left-hand, right-hand combination. Admits it has been tough for the bowlers and as batters they just wanted to make most of it. Explains that they don't try and necessarily go for only boundaries but the boys try different things. Says that the next game in St. Lucia will be a great one and he wants to win the close fought series.

Windies skipper, Jason Holder says it was a great effort from his team and credits Chris Gayle for his innings. Says both teams made it look difficult to bowl here and both sides batted well. States Morgan and Buttler batted really well and they (Windies) just had to go for it. Explains it was a case where they knew what they needed to and it was just a matter of them to be fearless and play their natural game. On being asked how high is Chris Gayle amongst the greatest Windies player, Jason Holder states that he is right at the top of Windies cricket and getting 10,000 runs in any form of cricket is not an easy task. Adds that he is looking for the final ODI and states that he is looking to level the series.
Earlier in the day, England posted 418 courtesy a 77-ball 150 from Jos Buttler and 88-ball 103 from skipper Eoin Morgan.

As for the bowlers, everyone except Mark Wood and Liam Plunkett were being hammered. Liam Plunkett and Adil Rashid were the stars with the ball picking up 4 and 5 wickets respectively. Liam Plunkett went wicket-less but had an outstanding economy rate of 5. Adil Rashid magical comeback in the game ensured the tourists take an unassailable lead in the series.

It looked like Windies innings would crumble after his wicket. Jason Holder didn't last long after his wicket and it looked like the writing was in the wall but Carlos Brathwaite and Ashley Nurse joined hands and stitched together an 88-run stand. Carlos Brathwaite played his best innings in ODI cricket and got to his maiden half century but could not guide his side home. But it was not enough as Adil Rashid spun his web and got rid off both the batsmen in two consecutive balls and wrapped the next two in the next three balls.

The innings didn't start in the best of fashions for the Windies. They lost 2 wickets in the first 6 overs. But Christopher Henry Gayle had turned on the beast mood and made a blistering 162 off just 97 balls. The Windies hardly went below the asking rate and the Gayle storm hit Grenada hard. He hit 11 boundaries and 14 maximums in his innings. The Gayle storm was blowing away the English bowlers but in the 35th over Ben Stokes got the breakthrough of the big man after being taken to the cleaners earlier. He was supported well by Darren Bravo who got his half century.

What a match! Wow. It looked like Windies were on course to chase the mammoth total of 419 but 4 wickets in the 48th over from Rashid ensured this match does not even go to the 50th over. And England won the game with 29 runs.

OUT! STUMPED! That ends the game! ENGLAND WIN BY 29 RUNS AND TAKE AN UNASSAILABLE 2-1 SERIES LEAD. Second ODI fifer for Rashid. The googly, outside off, Thomas walks into the shot but is comfortably beaten by the googly. He is well outside the crease and Buttler whips off the bails in a flash. England retain their number 1 ranking in ODIs as well.
Oshane Thomas walks out at number 11.

OUT! Caught! Third wicket in the over and this is folding up now. Rashid has his fourth. Floated, around middle, Bishoo gets down and mows the slog sweep. Unfortunately for him, finds Alex Hales to perfection at deep mid-wicket.
A vicious hat-trick ball. Full and around middle, the googly, Bishoo lunges to defend but is terribly beaten.
Sheldon Cottrell walks out to the middle. But he will be at the non-striker's end for the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Caught! This should be the final nail in the coffin. Rashid struts his stuff. Tossed up outside off, Brathwaite looks to slog but the ball spins away and induces a leading edge. Eoin Morgan runs a bit to his left from cover and takes it calmly. Good fight from Carlos but it was too much to do.
Devendra Bishoo is the new man in.

OUT! Taken this time! No usage of the life by Nurse. He departs. Floated, around middle, Ashley swings hard, rather, tries to heave but only gets a top edge. Short fine leg calls for it and Liam Plunkett takes it with ease. That ends the 88-run stand and the hosts are back in trouble. 30 more needed from 16 balls.

IN THE AIR... PUT DOWN! Spectacular effort from Ben Stokes. If there was one man in the field who could have got there, it was Stokes. But sadly, it was not to be. Full and around middle, Nurse swung this hard but the ball hit the toe end of the bat. It went flat towards long on where Ben Stokes charged in and dived but could not quite hang on. Two runs taken.
Length delivery on off, Ashley hits it towards cover and takes a single. Mark Wood is done for the evening and he finishes off with the figures of 10-0-60-4.
Fifty for Brathwaite. His first in ODIs. Back of a length delivery on the body. Holder gets on top of the bouncer and tucks it to the leg side for a  single.
Bouncer. On middle and leg, Brathwaite ducks underneath it. The umpire signals it one for the over.
Back of a length delivery on off, Nurse pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Excellent running! Full length delivery on middle and leg, Nurse tucks it towards mid-wicket and runs the first one hard. They look for two and get it easily.
Full length delivery on off, Brathwaite hits it towards cover and takes a single.
Mark Wood to bowl his final over.
Outside off, steered late to short third man for one more. 9 from the over, staying abreast with the required rate...
On middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! That will help! Boy, are we onto something here? 40 needed from 26 balls now! Short and outside off, Nurse rocks back and punches it through the covers for a boundary!
EDGED BUT NO SLIP! Full and outside off, Brathwaite swings hard but gets a thick outside edge which flies through the vacant slip region towards short third man. A quick single taken.
Fuller and around off, slogged towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Around middle, punched down to long on for a single.
Adil Rashid returns. 8-0-74-1 so far.
FOUR!!! Three-in-three. Full toss outside off, Nurse lofts it over covers and the ball crosses the ropes on a bounce for a boundary.  47 runs required off the last 5 overs.

FOUR! This is a better shot but also a poor fielding effort. Full length delivery outside off, Nurse lofts it over mid off. Root gives it chase and gets there but he mistimes the dive and the ball goes to the fence.
FOUR! This time he is not lucky to escape the full toss. It is on off, Nurse hits it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full toss outside off, Nurse looks to hit it through the line but gets an edge to it. The ball bounces and reaches the keeper.
Good length delivery around off, Brathwaite pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full length delivery on off, Nurse hits it towards long on for a single.
Chris Woakes replaces Adil Rashid.
Down the leg side, Brathwaite tucks it towards short fine leg. The fielder gets to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Concedes the second as well.
Dropped short, pulled towards deep backward square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off where the fielder fumbles and concedes the second.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
A short ball, pulled away for a single.
Outside off, Nurse feels for it but misses.
Mark Wood is back on. 8-0-47-4 so far.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, Carlos relaxes and defends it.
SIX! Two-in-two. Flighted delivery on off, Carlos sweeps it over mid-wicket. Ben Stokes in the deep, jumps and looks to catch it but cannot hold onto it and it goes through his hand for a maximum.
SIX!!! Massive, this is out of here. Flighted delivery on off, Brathwaite gets on one knee and sends it on the roof over mid-wicket.
On the pads, Ashley tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Nurse comes down the track, Rashid sees it and lands it short. Nurse can do nothing but hit it back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery on leg, Nurse looks to sweep it but gets hit on  the body.
FOUR! Brute power! A short ball, around off, Brathwaite pulls it with a horizontal bat and the ball races away to the mid-wicket fence! 81 needed in the last 8...
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run.
A bouncer, around off, Brathwaite ducks.
Pushes this down to long on for a single.
Around middle and off, on a length, defended back to the bowler.
Flatter on middle, Brathwaite hits it straight back to the bowler.
Short again, Brathwaite cuts it towards backward point and gets a couple as Joe Root comes from deep point and stops it.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Carlos defends it of his front foot.
Flighted on the stumps, Ashley defends it with soft hands towards point and gets a single.
FOUR! Short, wide and punished. Leg spinner outside off, Ashley cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Leg spinner shorter in length, Nurse cuts it towards the fielder at backward point for a single.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end. Meanwhile, Adil Rashid changes ends. 6-0-54-1 so far.
Full length delivery on middle and off, Ashley hits it straight, Plunkett dives to stop the single but cannot do so.
Back of a length delivery, Carlos guides it towards point and takes a single.
Good length delivery, Nurse defends it with soft hands and picks up a single.
Back of a length delivery on off, Nurse goes to the off stump and goes for the scoop. He takes his eyes off and gets hit on the body. A very unnecessary and unusual shot from Nurse.
Full length delivery on off, Nurse taps it back to the bowler.
On the pads, Brathwaite tucks it to the leg side and rotates the strike.
Liam Plunkett back into the attack.
Outside off, Ashley backs away and slashes hard but misses.
On middle, worked to the leg side for one more.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Outside off, yorker length, Nurse swings hard but misses.

Outside off, Brathwaite looks to tuck it to the leg side but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. The batsmen take a late call for the single and eventually make it. Ben Stokes rushes across and has a shy at the striker's end  but misses.
Landed outside off, chopped down to third man for a couple.
Loopy delivery on the stumps, Ashley defends it to see off the over. A good one from Rashid, just 2 off it.
Short again, Nurse cuts it to the fielder at point.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Nurse looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the mid riff region.
Shorter in length, leg spinner from Rashid, Nurse cuts it behind point for a single.
Living dangerously. Flighted delivery on off, this is a googly by Rashid. Nurse completely misreads it and the ball hits the inside edge off his defensive bat and goes uppishly to the leg side.
Close! Leg spinner which is short in length, Nurse looks to cut it but it is too close to his body. It goes past the outside edge.
FOUR! Bad bowling. Down the leg side, helped to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Cheeky! Outside off, Brathwaite goes back, waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it late to the third man fence!
A full toss outside off, Carlos swings hard but miscues it. The ball is high in the air and long on and mid-wicket rush to their right and left respectively but are bisected. Two runs taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
A short ball, pulled uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery outside off, Nurse gets on one knee and looks to hit it across the line. He gets a big inside edge onto his pads.
Ashley Nurse walks in.

OUT!!! Stumped. Yes, Holder is a goner. Flighted delivery on off, the ball spins away after pitching. Holder stretches and looks to drive it through the line but misses. Jos Buttler behind the stumps takes the bails off in a flash and is up in joy as he feels they have got their man. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs and replays show his foot was in the air and the Windies skipper has to depart. Big wicket for England. Only the handful English supporters are enjoying it. Into the lower order now.
STUMPING APPEAL! Is Holder gone? England are confident...
Tossed up on the stumps, Holder defends it off his front foot.
Flighted on the stumps, Brathwaite goes aerial but does not time it. It goes to the fielder on a bounce to the fielder at the deep for a single.
Brilliant ball. Flighted on middle Brathwaite looks to flick it but misses. The ball hits him on the pads and there is an appeal from the English players but the umpire turns it down.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Holder hits it towards cover and takes a single.

FOUR! Not quite intended but he will take it. Short and outside off, Brathwaite looks to steer it towards third man but the ball goes off the bottom half of the bat towards third man. The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot straight to mid-wicket.
Full on middle and off, flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Outside off, on a length, Brathwaite looks to push but misses.
Carlos Brathwaite walks in now. Can he do something which will make the people remember his name?

OUT! TIMBERRRRR! Is that it for the Windies? Is that the game? Big, bigger, biggest moment of this chase. The Universe Boss is gone. You miss I hit formula. Stokes keeps it straight, on a length and Gayle, for once, misses his swing. The ball skids on off the deck and shatters the stumps. England are pumped up. Why wouldn't they be? Gayle departs for 162 from 97 balls. 11 fours and 14 sixes. 124 more needed from 95 balls...
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Gayle milks it through long on for a single.
Full length delivery, Holder  plays it towards long on and takes a single.
On a length around off, Jason pushes it to the fielder at point.
Play and a miss. Good length delivery outside off, Holder looks to hit it but misses.
On middle and leg, Gayle flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Yorker length on the stumps, Gayle looks to hit it on the leg side but it hits his bat and onto his boot.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Outside off, punched in front of point for just one.
A length ball outside off, swiped through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed uppishly towards mid off.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length delivery on the leg side, Gayle looks to flick it but gets hit on the pad. The ball goes to the on side and Gayle takes a quick run. The umpire signals it as a leg bye.

Full length delivery on off, Jason tucks it to the on side for a single.
Yorker length outside off, Gayle guides it towards mid off and takes a run.
Wide! Bowls this one down the leg side, Gayle looks to flick but misses.
Full toss outside off, Gayle leaves it thinking it is outside the tramline but it is not.
Full length delivery on the stumps, Gayle taps it back to the bowler.
Full length delivery on off, Holder flicks it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
SIX! And another! Full and outside off, Gayle launches this over long off! 21 from the over.
SIX! There we go! Tossed up, around off, Gayle gets down and mows it over mid-wicket!
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Gayle paddles it to the fine leg fence!

NOT OUT. Gayle is just in. Buttler is a fraction late in taking the bails off. The wrong 'un outside off, Chris looks to swing hard but is done in, in the air. The ball spins away from him and his foot is dragged out. It is referred upstairs but replays show that Buttler was a tad slow in taking the bails off.
Stumping appeal! Is Gayle gone? Referred upstairs...
FOUR! No one in the deep. Tossed up outside off, Gayle reaches out and lofts it over cover for a boundary!
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

DRINKS BREAK. Possible? Not possible? Well, with Gayle at the crease, anything is possible. England were 196/3 at this stage. They score 222 in the last 20. Windies need 157. Problem is - one wicket and that might just derail the chase. Adil Rashid is back on at last. 3-0-29-0 so far.
Yorker outside off, CG looks to dig it out but misses.
Full and around off, worked to the leg side for a run.
Full and pitched well outside leg, Chris misses his flick and is hit on the pads. The ball deflects towards point and a leg bye is taken.

FOUR! BANG! That was powerfully hit. Short and around middle, Gayle pulls it through mid-wicket and the ball races away. Alex Hales has to move just around 10 paces to his right which he does and tumbles but the ball is so forcefully hit that it goes through!
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Excellent yorker on middle, dug out back to the bowler.
Chris Woakes returns. 6-0-65-0 so far.
On middle and leg, flicked away for one.
Outside off, played through point for a run.
Down the leg side, Chris looks to tuck but the ball goes of the bottom half of the bat towards short fine leg. A run taken.
A length ball now, in line of the stumps, Gayle swings hard but finds mid on.
Another loose chip from Holder, again short of a fielder, this time of Ben Stokes at mid off who has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Fuller length, pushed wide of mid off for a quick single.
WIDE. A bouncer, around leg, Gayle ducks.
FOUR!!! Back of a length delivery on off and middle, Holder pulls it away for the second boundary of the over.

In the air and safe again. Holder is riding his luck here. Good length delivery on off, Holder looks to drive it but it comes off the upper half of his bat and the ball goes uppishly short of the mid off fielder.
WIDE! Wood misses his line and sprays this down the leg side. Jason looks to flick it but misses. Umpire signals it as wide.
Back of a length delivery, Holder pulls it straight to the fielder.
FOUR! Full length delivery on off, Holder takes the aerial route. He lofts it over the mid off fielder. He does not time it well but has enough to go to the fence on a bounce.
Full and around off, solidly defended back to the bowler.
On a good length around off, coming in with the angle, Gayle taps it to the off side and takes a quick single.

In the air... but safe again. Pitched on length, this one waits and comes onto the batsman. Holder checks his shot and it goes uppishly towards mid off. The ball falls short of Ben Stokes there. Jason Holder is somewhat struggling to time the ball here.
On the pads, Gayle tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Holder nudges it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Cross seam delivery on middle and leg, Jason looks to flick but misses and gets hit high on the thigh pad.
In the air...but safe. Length delivery outside off, Holder looks to pull but hits it uppishly towards mid on. The ball falls short of the fielder there and goes to Moeen Ali on a bounce.
Good length delivery on off, Holder taps it back to the bowler.
On the pads, Gayle flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, Holder pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Full length delivery on the stumps, the Windies skipper defends it off his front foot.
Once again back of a length delivery outside off, Gayle gets a top edge and it goes uppishly towards third man for a single.
Back of a length delivery on the body, Gayle defends it off his back foot.
Outside off, punched through the off side for a single.
Length delivery on off, Jason drives it towards cover and keeps the strike.

In the air....but safe. Cross seam delivery on off, the ball holds onto the pitch and comes to the batsman. Holder checks his shot and chips it uppishly over the bowler's head. Stokes gets to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. His throw is wayward and Buttler cannot gather it which allows them to take the second.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the pads once again, Gayle looks to flick it but gets hit on the pads and they steal a leg bye.
Length delivery on the pads, Gayle tucks it towards the short fine leg fielder.
Good length delivery outside off, Holder guides it towards third man for a single.
Liam Plunkett back into the attack.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. A double-wicket over for Wood, his figures read 6-0-34-4.
FOUR! Not a bad shot at all. Fractionally short in length, Holder pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Jason Holder, the skipper, walks in at number 6, replacing Hetmyer.

OUT! Straight to the man! Sad, sad batting. Six first ball and then a wicket on the next. Literally thrown it away. Hetmyer probably forgot that there is SOMEONE at the other end who just needs some support. He can single-handedly take Windies to a 2-1 series lead. But needs someone to partner him. Another short ball, Shimron looks but this time it is a 143 kph delivery. Hence, SH is slightly late onto the shot. Still, he connects decently. However, because of the extra pace, he does not get enough elevation. The hit is flat and Alex Hales makes no mistake at deep mid-wicket. 4 wickets down, all the 4 to Wood!
SIX! Ha! This bloke does not care a dime about the first ball, does he? Short ball, around middle, Hetmyer just pulls this with aplomb over mid-wicket!
The attacking batsmen just keep coming. Shimron Hetmyer is in now.

OUT! Caught! Wood gives the breakthrough! The 176-run stand is broken. Is this the break England were looking for? A short ball, around middle, Bravo, as has been trying since the last few overs, looks to deposit this into the stands. He had been successful in the last 2-3 overs but not this time. Looks to pull but the ball cramps him for room. Also, the pace of Wood does the trick, making the ball come quickly at the batsman. Little Bravo looks to pull but gets a top edge which goes straight up in the air. Ben Stokes takes a sitter at short mid-wicket. Well played, Bravo. Played perfect foil to the big-hitting Gayle.
Mark Wood returns. 5-0-23-2 so far.
Dot ball. Yes a dot ball to finish off the over. Gayle lets Moeen go and defends this loopy delivery off his front foot.

SIX!!! This is so simple for Gayle. Flighted delivery on off and middle, Gayle sends it to the crowd over the long on for another biggie. Moeen has had a torrid time against Gayle and Windies this series.

Beauty. Tossed up delivery on middle, the ball spins away after pitching. Gayle looks to defend but gets an outside edge and the ball goes past the vacant slip region and towards third man. The batsman come back for the second.

FOUR! Flighted delivery on leg, Gayle makes room and hits it over the covers for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle, Gayle defends it off his front foot.

A bouncer, right at the head of the batsman, Darren ducks.
Full and outside leg, flicked through mid-wicket for one more.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.

SIX! The first ball of the over has been tonked away! A length ball, around middle and leg, Bravo just swings this cleanly over long on!

On the pads once again, Bravo nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Ali bowls it on the pads, Gayle flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Once again shorter in length, Darren pulls this one for a single.
FOUR! Short and punished. Moeen lands it on off, Bravo gets on his back foot and cuts it wide of the diving fielder at point for a boundary.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Bravo defends it off his front foot.
Moeen Ali to roll his arm over.

Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.

DRINKS BREAK. Interesting passage of play. England had slowed down after Powerplay 1 while on the other hand, Windies have upped their ante. 59 runs have come in the 6 overs since the fielding restrictions were lifted slightly. The ask is still tall, with 285 runs more needed from 204 balls, but you never know these days in cricket...

A bit on the shorter side, steered towards third man for a run.

Bouncer. Bravo sits under this one and lets it go to Buttler behind the stumps.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Darren pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket.

Full length delivery on off and middle, Bravo looks to go over the bowler's head. He does not time it well and the ball doesn't have the legs to go to the fence. The fielder stops it and Bravo comes back for the second.
Keeps it outside off, Gayle taps it to cover.
On off, Bravo pushes it to cover and gets to the non striker's end.
Good length on the pads, Bravo looks to defend as the ball goes to the off side from an outside edge.
On a fuller length outside off, played straight to point.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Bravo misses his flick.
Outside off, Gayle cuts it to point and a misfield occurs there. Still a dot ball.
Outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
No, they cannot. Caught but to no avail. Full length delivery on the pads, Bravo looks to go over the mid on fielder but ends up chipping it to Moeen Ali. 22 runs off his first over.
NO ball. Things going from bad to worse for stokes. Bowls a 134kph beamer. Bravo ducks underneath it and the umpire signals it as no ball. Free Hit to follow. Can Windies make the most of it?
Finally some relief for Ben Stokes. Full length delivery around off, Gayle plays it with soft hands towards cover and takes a single.
FOUR! No place to hide here for Stokes. He bowls it short and Gayle plays a short arm jab behind square leg for a boundary.
SIX!!! Two-in-two. This is a mammoth one. Full length delivery on middle and off, Gayle hits it across the line and sends the ball two rows back over the long on fence for a huge six.
SIX! This is even better, Stokes goes full and Gayle goes over the ropes. Full length delivery on off, Gayle heaves it over the long off fence for a 71m maximum.
FOUR! What a way to get to his 51st ODI fifty. Length delivery outside off, Gayle looks go over mid off. He does not time it well but has enough on it to reach the fence on a bounce.
Ben Stokes introduced into the attack.
Back of a length and outside off, Gayle pushes it to cover and takes a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Good length ball outside off, Bravo makes room for himself and pulls it past the non-striker towards long on. A boundary results.
On a length around middle, CG steers it to third man for a single.
A length ball around middle, Chris looks to heave but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Full length on stumps, Gayle jams it out.
Powerplay 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Back of a length on the stumps, Bravo blocks it. England at this stage were 89/0. Windies are 75/2. Those two wickets would worry the dressing room a bit.
Once again shorter in length, Gayle pulls it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
Excellent planning this. After three short balls Wood bowls this full on off, Gayle gets his bat down and hits it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Again challenging Gayle to pull the short length ball. Chris goes for it but misses.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Gayle looks to pull it but misses.
Bouncer. It is on the leg side, Gayle ducks underneath it. He looks to the umpire for a wide but there is no signal.
Full length delivery on the stumps, Bravo sees off the over by defending it off his front foot.
Good length delivery on off, Darren pushes it to the fielder at point.
Follows that boundary with a classical front foot defense.
SIX! Bravo takes the aerial route. Off cutter outside off. It is right in the slot for Bravo and he lofts it over the cover fence for a maximum.
On a length around off, Bravo hits it to the fielder at mid off.
Wide! Plunkett misses his line and bowls it down the leg side. Darren looks to flick it but misses. The umpire signals it as wide.
Good length delivery on off, Bravo hits it towards point and looks for a single but Gayle sends him back. Bravo needs to remember Gayle is his partner and quick singles will be hard to get here.
Liam Plunkett is the first bowling change of the innings.
Full length delivery on the pads, Bravo flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery this time on off, Bravo hits it to the fielder at cover.
Once again on the pads, Darren gets a faint inside edge onto his pads. Once again there is a stifled appeal which is turned down by the umpire.
Length delivery on the pads, Bravo flicks it towards short fine leg and for some reason there was a shout from the bowler for lbw.
Good length delivery on off and middle, Darren taps it back to the bowler.
Back of a length delivery on the body, Gayle puts his balance on the back leg and tucks it to the on side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. 21 FROM THE OVER!
Finally some sanity. A length ball, around middle, watchfully tapped to the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Poor line and length. Fine leg is up and the line is outside leg, that too, full. Enjoy yourself. Gayle does so. Tickles it past the fielder in the ring.
FOUR! 16 in 3 balls! Very full and outside off, Gayle backs away and looks to steer it behind point but the ball flies off the outside edge and just escapes the fielder at point!
SIX! Boy o boy! The big man is in the mood again! Full and outside off, Gayle backs away and lofts it over cover for a biggie again!
SIX! Easy peasy. A length ball, in line of middle, Gayle swings hard and gets it over mid-wicket!
Once again outside off, Darren offers no stroke to it and lets it go to the keeper.
Good length delivery just outside the off stump. Bravo knows where his off stump is and leaves it alone.
Bouncer. It is outside off, Bravo sees it and lets it go to the keeper.
Wood bowls this one down the leg side. Bravo looks to flick but misses. The umpire does not signal it as wide. Maybe it flicked his thigh pad.
Darren Bravo walks in at number 4, replacing Hope.

OUT! Caught! Windies lose their second. Good length delivery outside off, Hope goes to poke it and gets a thick outside edge. Buttler cannot do much wrong and dives to his right to take a good catch. The hosts now are in big trouble. They need their big man Gayle to play a big innings.

FOUR! Lucky boundary for Hope and Windies. Back of a length delivery on the stumps, the ball rises onto the batsman. Hope takes his eye off as he looks to flick but takes his eyes off and it comes off the edge of his bat. Luckily for him it goes over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Chris defends it to see off the over.
Slower delivery from Woakes. It is bowled full, Gayle taps it back to the bowler.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Hope nudges it towards square leg and gets a single.
Bowls this on the pad, Gayle looks to flick but misses. The balkl hits him on his thigh pad and they steal a single. The umpire signals it as leg bye.
SIX! Make that two-in-two. Woakes changes his length and bowls it full. Gayle goes downtown and lofts this over the long on fence for another maximum.
SIX! Woakes bowls it short, Gayle rocks onto his back foot and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full on middle and off, Shai drives it straight to the bowler.
Back of a length, Hope punches it to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery outside off, Gayle guides it towards third man with a slanted bat and they rotate the strike.

Back of a length on the pads, Hope looks to tucks it away towards fine leg  but gets hit high on his thigh pad.The ball still goes to the desired region and they take a single. The umpire signals it as a leg bye.
Good length delivery on off, Hope starts his innings with a solid defense.
Shai Hope walks in at number 3, replacing Campbell.

OUT!!! Caught. Good length delivery on middle, Campbell looks to hit it across the line and pull it away. He gets a top edge onto this one and the ball goes uppishly straight to the fielder at cover. Root there makes no mistake and takes a very comfortable catch. The English players are up in celebration and not the start Windies were looking for.
Once again a shorter delivery, Chris this time pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
SIX! Short and punished. Woakes bowls this slightly shorter in length, Gayle picks the length early and gets onto his back foot. He pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Back of a length on the stumps, Gayle watchfully defends it.
Excellent fielding. Length delivery on middle, Gayle rocks onto his back foot and cuts it towards cover. The fielder there dives to his right and stops a certain boundary.
On a length, Chris blocks it away off his back foot.
Good length delivery on off, Gayle plays it late and guides it towards the fielder at short third man.
FOUR! Good end to the over. Full length delivery on middle and leg, Campbell frees his arms and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Campbell looks to hit it through the line but misses.
SIX!!! What a shot! Full length delivery on middle, Campbell gets down on one knee and loft it over the backward square leg fence for a maximum.
Wood pulls back his length and John cuts it hard but straight to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Full length delivery on off and middle, Campbell lofts it over the bowler's head towards long off for a boundary.
Starts with a full length delivery on off, Gayle gets an inside edge and the ball goes to the on side for a single.
Mark Wood to partner Chris Woakes with the other new ball.
Bowls this one outside off, Campbell looks to cut but misses.
Length delivery outside off, Campbell cuts it brilliantly but straight to the fielder at cover-point.
Fuller this time on middle and leg, Gayle nudges it towards square leg and gets to the other end.
Good length delivery on the pads, Campbell tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
Length again around off, Gayle taps it to third man to get off the mark.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands in a good length ball outside off. Gayle watches it go through to the keeper.
We are back for the chase. Openers, Chris Gayle and John Campbell walk out to the middle. Chris Woakes will bowl the first over. 2 slips in place for him.
